brief.en: Lobs stunning cores down three lanes
brief.zh: 向三行投射眩晕的苹果核

description.en: Apple Mortars lob apple cores that damage and briefly stun zombies over three lanes.
description.zh: 苹果迫击炮向邻近三行发射有轻微眩晕效果的苹果核子弹。

chat.en: Apple Mortar stuns three zombies dead in their tracks. SPAF! That'll show 'em! That'll show ALL of them!
chat.zh: 苹果迫击炮让三个僵尸死死的定在原地。啪！这就是杀鸡儆猴！让别的僵尸好好看清楚我的威力！
